m2MailEventDispatch.summary: Moteur d'envoi e-mail evenementiel par roles (event -> regle -> fromRole/toRole -> resolver M1 -> template -> gateway -> SendLog), idempotent. BRIQUE ADDITIVE : envois directs CONSERVES (moteur en shadow), mailService/postToBrevo/sendLogService/SendLog/webhook NON modifies ; aucune UI ; aucun vrai e-mail (Brevo mocke). Backend 467 + audits 36/20 ; frontend inchange (78).
m2MailEventDispatch.flag: MAIL_ROLE_RESOLVER_ENABLED=false (.env.example) ; isMailRoleResolverEnabled() lu a l'execution. false -> subscriber no-op (envois existants inchanges). true -> dispatch (shadow tant qu'un envoi direct existe).
m2MailEventDispatch.rules: constants/mailDispatchRules.js : {eventName,templateKey,fromRole,toRole,contextType,enabled,directSenderExists}. sale.finalized->vente, booking.confirmed->booking_confirmed, refund.succeeded->refund_confirmed (commerciale->client) ; commission.available->commission_available, commission.reminder_sent->commission_reminder (support->commerciale). TOUTES directSenderExists:true (shadow, anti-doublon). Aucune adresse dans les regles.
m2MailEventDispatch.ledger: models/MailEventDelivery.js : statuts shadow/skipped_duplicate_direct_sender/skipped_rule_disabled/skipped_template_missing/identity_missing/client_missing/sent/failed. Index unique {eventName,contextType,contextId,templateKey} -> pas de double e-mail au replay.
m2MailEventDispatch.service: services/mail/mailEventDispatchService.js : resolveMailRule ; dispatchTemplateByRoles (envoi REEL : loadTemplate -> resolveMailEnvelope (M1) -> render withMailThemeVars/replaceTemplateVariables -> postToBrevo (cree SendLog : templateKey + metadata.tags [transactional,<key>,from:<role>,to:<role>,role-engine] + recipientHash + contextType/Id) ; statuts skipped_template_missing/identity_missing/client_missing/sent/failed ; ne throw jamais) ; dispatchMailForEvent (regle+flag+idempotence ledger+shadow). Jamais de fallback hardcode, jamais de secret.
m2MailEventDispatch.subscriber: subscribers/mailEventSubscriber.js : subscribe(eventName,handleMailEvent) pour chaque regle ; flag off -> no-op ; best-effort (try/catch, n'interrompt jamais l'emetteur). Enregistre dans app.js (registerMailEventSubscribers) apres les autres subscribers.
m2MailEventDispatch.compat: SendLog enum STRICT inchange (queued/sent/delivered/opened/bounced/failed) -> statuts M2 sur le ledger MailEventDelivery. EventLog email.* inchanges. Roles via metadata.tags. Flag false -> prod inchangee ; flag true -> regles en shadow -> aucun doublon.
m2MailEventDispatch.tests: +25 backend -> 467. mailDispatchRules (5), mailEventDispatchService (9), mailEventSubscriber (4), mailEventDeliveryIdempotence (4), mailRoleResolverIntegration (3). Brevo mocke (getCredential+fetch). AUCUN vrai e-mail.
m2MailEventDispatch.limites: Chemin evenementiel reste en SHADOW (payloadSafe sans e-mail client + envoi direct existant). Vraie capacite d'envoi prouvee par dispatchTemplateByRoles (tests) pour de futurs appelants avec contexte client. Aucun envoi direct retire. Pas d'UI. Pas de metadata role sur EmailTemplate (regles = source de verite).
m2MailEventDispatch.prochaineMission: M3 Notification Target Engine : enrichir le contexte d'event / appeler dispatchTemplateByRoles depuis les flux disposant du client pour MIGRER progressivement un envoi direct -> moteur (retirer directSenderExists, bascule par event), ciblage destinataires/canaux, puis UI React Manager/Dev (identites + regles + journal MailEventDelivery).

m1CommunicationIdentity.summary: Fondation backend des identites de communication (support/commerciale + verification sender Brevo + domaine DNS + resolver fromRole/toRole), inspiree de LYCARZ. BRIQUE ADDITIVE : mailService/SendLog/EventLog/webhook Brevo NON modifies ; aucun envoi/template migre ; aucune UI React ; aucun vrai e-mail (Brevo mocke). m1CommunicationIdentity.model: models/CommunicationIdentity.js : role(support/commerciale)+scope(platform/institute) imposes (ROLE_SCOPE support=platform, commerciale=institute), status(unverified/verification_pending/verified/disabled), active, provider brevo, providerSenderId/providerVerificationStatus/...VerifiedAt, domain/domainAuthenticated/domainStatus/dnsRecords[], verification{requestedAt,verifiedAt,lastErrorCode,lastErrorMessageSafe}, metadata/createdBy/updatedBy. CLIENT jamais dans l'enum (non configurable). Index unique partiel {role,scope} ou active:true. AUCUN secret.
m1CommunicationIdentity.service: services/communicationIdentityService.js : createCommunicationIdentity, listCommunicationIdentities, setActiveCommunicationIdentity, requestSenderVerification, confirmSenderVerification, refreshIdentityVerificationStatus, getActiveIdentity, assertIdentityReady(role,scope,{mode:strict|warn}). client rejete (client_not_configurable) ; email lowercase ; displayName requis ; active seulement si verified (identity_not_verified) ; setActive sequentiel (sans transaction). domainAuthenticated:false n'empeche pas ready. CommunicationIdentityError {code,status}.
m1CommunicationIdentity.brevoAdapter: services/communicationBrevoSenderAdapter.js (MOCKABLE) : requestSenderVerification (POST /v3/senders -> Brevo envoie l'OTP), confirmSenderVerification (PUT /v3/senders/:id/validate), getSenderStatus (GET /v3/senders, source de verite active), getDomainStatus (GET /v3/senders/domains/:d, best-effort). Cle via getCredential('brevo',{role:'api_key'}). JAMAIS d'OTP maison, JAMAIS de secret renvoye. provider_not_connected si cle absente.
m1CommunicationIdentity.resolver: services/communicationRoleResolver.js : resolveSender(role) (support/commerciale -> identite active), resolveRecipient(role,ctx) (client -> context.client.email), resolveMailEnvelope({fromRole,toRole,context}) -> {from:{email,name,role}, to:[{email,name?,role}]}. Erreur controlee si identite absente (identity_not_ready). JAMAIS de fallback hardcode. NON CABLE aux envois existants (M2).
m1CommunicationIdentity.endpoints: Aucun public. Dev (requireStrictDev) /api/gestion/dev/communication-identities : GET /, POST /support, POST /:id/request-verification|confirm-verification|set-active|refresh. Admin/Dev (requireAdminOrDev) /api/gestion/communication-identities : GET /, POST /commerciale, POST /:id/... . support=dev only, commerciale=admin/dev, client jamais configurable. Controller bloque la gestion d'un support par non-dev (forbidden_support_identity 403). Payload safe (toSafe).
m1CommunicationIdentity.roles: support -> adresse plateforme/dev -> support->institut. commerciale -> adresse institut/admin -> institut->client. client -> resolu depuis context.client.email, JAMAIS stocke/configure.
m1CommunicationIdentity.tests: +31 backend -> 442. communicationIdentityModel (6), Service (9), RoleResolver (7), Routes (7), BrevoVerification (2). Brevo mocke (vi.mock adapter, ou getCredential+fetch). AUCUN vrai e-mail.
m1CommunicationIdentity.compat: mailService/buildSender(MAIL_FROM)/postToBrevo/SendLog/EventLog/webhook Brevo INCHANGES. Le resolver n'est pas branche -> envois actuels identiques. Aucun secret expose.
m1CommunicationIdentity.limites: Resolver NON cable aux dispatchers (templates utilisent toujours MAIL_FROM). Pas d'UI React. Domaine DNS best-effort. assertIdentityReady dispo mais pas encore utilise par les envois.
m1CommunicationIdentity.prochaineMission: M2 Mail Event Dispatch Engine : cabler les envois sur resolver fromRole/toRole + assertIdentityReady (gate expediteur), remplacer progressivement buildSender() par l'identite active, dispatch evenementiel (event -> template -> fromRole/toRole). Puis UI React Manager/Dev de gestion des identites.

Base = env only (jamais client) + validee http(s) -> pas d'open redirect ; base sans schema -> fallback Vanilla.
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.backendSessionStatus: stripePaymentQueryService.getSessionStatusFromRequest : si id commence par cs_ -> stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve -> payment_intent -> suite inchangee. Chemin pi_ identique. cs_ sans PI -> {status:'open',payment_status:'unpaid'}. Reponse inchangee.
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.apiClient: @bs/api-client/checkout : getCheckoutSessionStatus(sessionId) GET /api/stripe/session-status?session_id= -> {status:succeeded|pending|failed|unknown, paymentStatus} (mapping prudent). @bs/api-client/auth : login(email,password) POST /auth/login (cookie HttpOnly). getSession/logout existants. AUCUN token localStorage.
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.pages: PaymentSuccessPage (/paiement/succes : free=1 confirme ; session_id=cs_ -> getCheckoutSessionStatus ; payment_intent_id=pi_ -> getPaymentResult ; clearCart UNIQUEMENT si confirme/free, jamais si pending/unknown/failed ; wording prudent 'confirmation en cours'). PaymentCancelPage (panier conserve). LoginPage (/connexion : login -> useAuth().refresh() -> redirect interne VALIDE (?redirect= commence par / mais pas // ; sinon /checkout si panier sinon /), anti open-redirect ; erreurs inline ; pas d'inscription/reset/OAuth).
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.checkoutAuth: /checkout 401 -> etat 'Connexion requise' + lien /connexion?redirect=/checkout ; panier conserve (local) ; reprise du paiement apres login. Pas de RequireAuth autour de /checkout (backend = autorite).
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.tests: Backend +7 (hostedCheckoutReactReturnUrls 3, checkoutSessionStatus 4) -> 411. Frontend +13 (r2cReturnLogin 9 + ajustements) -> 91. Aucun import @stripe/stripe-js, aucun hex tsx, aucun token front.
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.limites: Retour React effectif si CHECKOUT_RETURN_BASE_URL defini (sinon Vanilla, defaut). Pas d'inscription/reset/OAuth (login minimal). Checkout centre prestation. Espace client/manager/dev hors perimetre.
reactR2CStripeReturnLogin.prochaineMission: React R3 : espace client React (mes formations/reservations/commandes) ou demarrage manager React (onboarding contrat + commissions hebergees U3). Etendre checkout React aux produits/formations/cartes cadeaux.

stripeCommission.rule: La commission Stripe est calculée sur le montant réellement encaissé par Stripe, pas sur le montant total de la commande.

totalAmount.rule: sale.totalAmount est le montant CATALOGUE COMPLET (avant déduction carte cadeau). Il sert de base pour le revenu net : totalAmount - stripeFee/100 - commissionAmount.
totalAmount.note: La carte cadeau est un mode de paiement, pas une remise. Sa valeur est déjà comptabilisée en revenu lors de la vente de la carte.

eventContextEnrichment.notificationFields: Notification.eventId/eventName/contextType/contextId (SAFE). triggerNotification(type,vars,{event}) persiste; subscriber propage + enrichit variables. targetRole M3A inchange.

mailEventActivation.description: M3C (2026-06-29) — 1er flux e-mail migre du direct vers le moteur evenementiel M2. Pilote par MAIL_ROLE_RESOLVER_ENABLED.
mailEventActivation.migrated: refund.succeeded — regle directSenderExists:false, enabled:true, mode:'active' (templateKey refund_confirmed + variante refund_confirmed_service).
mailEventActivation.shadow: booking.confirmed (misalignement event/email — voir rapport 179), sale.finalized, commission.available, commission.reminder_sent.
mailEventActivation.variableBuilder: services/mail/mailEventVariableBuilder.js — buildRefundSucceededVariables (parite via buildCommonMailVars, choisit la variante), buildBookingConfirmedVariables, buildMailVariablesForRule.
mailEventActivation.dispatch: dispatchMailForEvent(..., { context, templateKeyOverride }) — templateKey effectif pour variante; ledger MailEventDelivery idempotent sur ce templateKey.
mailEventActivation.subscriber: mailEventSubscriber — regle active: resout client+variables et dispatche (commerciale->client); regle shadow: comportement M2 inchange.
mailEventActivation.directGating: refundExecutionService.sendRefundConfirmedEmailInternal: event TOUJOURS emis; if(isMailRoleResolverEnabled()) return (e-mail direct legacy seulement si flag false).
mailEventActivation.rollback: MAIL_ROLE_RESOLVER_ENABLED=false -> direct legacy (subscriber no-op, pas de ledger). true -> moteur (direct off, ledger sent). Une seule voie active.
mailEventActivation.prodActivation: Identite commerciale active+verified requise; templates refund_confirmed(_service) publies; passer le flag true; surveiller MailEventDelivery/SendLog; rollback flag false.
mailEventActivation.next: M3D — aligner puis migrer booking.confirmed, etendre aux autres flux non comptables.

bookingConfirmedActivation.description: M3D (2026-06-29) — alignement + activation booking.confirmed vers le moteur evenementiel M2. Pilote par MAIL_ROLE_RESOLVER_ENABLED.
bookingConfirmedActivation.alignment: booking.confirmed emis par TOUS les chemins de confirmation: checkout (checkoutBookingService, deja) + report de creneau (sessionCancellationFlowService, AJOUTE). contextType service_booking, contextId=booking._id.
bookingConfirmedActivation.rule: mailDispatchRules booking.confirmed -> directSenderExists:false, enabled:true, mode:'active' (commerciale->client, templateKey booking_confirmed).
bookingConfirmedActivation.variables: mailEventVariableBuilder.buildBookingConfirmedVariables complete (parite legacy: cancellationdays, paymenttype, depositamount, remainingamount, dates, practitionername). Client via ServiceBooking.findById. Aucun e-mail dans EventLog.
bookingConfirmedActivation.directGating: sessionCancellationFlowService report: event toujours emis; e-mail direct sendBookingConfirmedEmail gate par if(!isMailRoleResolverEnabled()). Checkout: pas d'e-mail direct booking_confirmed (rien a gater).
bookingConfirmedActivation.idempotence: cle = booking._id + templateKey. Report cree un NOUVEAU ServiceBooking (nouveau _id) -> nouvelle confirmation legitime; replay strict (meme _id) -> 1 e-mail. Pas besoin d'inclure la date.
bookingConfirmedActivation.rollback: flag false -> report=direct legacy, checkout=pas de booking_confirmed (historique). flag true -> moteur pour les deux. Au checkout flag true: vente(shadow direct)+booking_confirmed(engine)=2 e-mails distincts (pas un doublon).
bookingConfirmedActivation.testNotes: mailEventActivationBooking.test.js (M3C, booking shadow) supprime. mailEventDeliveryIdempotence repointe sur sale.finalized (regle shadow).
bookingConfirmedActivation.next: M3E — envisager sale.finalized (comptable, prudence) ou consolider la supervision du journal MailEventDelivery/SendLog.

mailSupervision.description: M3E (2026-06-29) — supervision backend lecture seule MailEventDelivery + SendLog. Vues dev (tout safe) et admin (institut/client).

mailSupervision.endpointsAdmin: requireGestionRole roleView=admin — GET /api/gestion/mail-deliveries[/:id|/stats], GET /api/gestion/send-logs[/stats]. Montes avant les routeurs dev-only broad-mount.
mailSupervision.filters: status, eventName, templateKey, fromRole, toRole, contextType, contextId, dateFrom, dateTo, limit (max 100). Enums verifiees, dates invalides ignorees, aucune regex utilisateur.
mailSupervision.stats: deliveries: total, byStatus, byTemplate, byEvent, last24h, failuresLast24h, shadowCount/activeCount (mode regle). sendlogs: total, byStatus, byTemplate, last24h, failuresLast24h.
mailSupervision.privacy: jamais d'e-mail (recipientHash SHA-256 seul), jamais de secret/payload. Admin ne voit pas la plateforme: deliveries fromRole=commerciale OU toRole=client; sendlogs denylist (password_reset, email_confirmation_code, commission_*, site_*). Detail admin hors audience -> 404.
mailSupervision.reactApiClient: frontend-react/packages/api-client/src/manager/mailSupervision.ts (listMailDeliveries, getMailDeliveryDetail, getMailDeliveryStats, listSendLogs, getSendLogStats + types). Cible endpoints admin. Aucun ecran.
mailSupervision.limits: lecture seule (aucune relance), pas d'UI React, sendLogId rarement renseigne (correlation best-effort par contexte), attempts=1, pas de pagination curseur reelle.
mailSupervision.next: M3F — ecran React de supervision OU lien delivery<->sendLog + actions de relance, avant migration sale.finalized.

communicationCenterReact.description: M4 (2026-06-29) — ecran React Communication Center (app manager, mobile-first), separe admin/dev. AUCUN backend modifie (branche sur M1 identites + M3E supervision).
communicationCenterReact.feature: apps/manager/src/features/communication/ — CommunicationCenterLayout, IdentityManager (react-query create/request/confirm/setActive/refresh), VerificationPanel, IdentityForm, DnsStatusPanel, MailDeliveriesView/SendLogsView, MailFilterBar/MobileFilterDrawer, MailStatsCards, listes en cards, StatusBadge/RoleBadge. communicationCenterReact.limits: lecture seule sur les journaux (aucune relance/renvoi), pas de Template Studio ni Theme Studio, pas de migration sale.finalized, pas de modification des regles d'envoi, pas de pagination curseur. Le verrou final reste backend.
communicationCenterReact.next: M5 — Mail Template Studio (edition par role) ou actions de supervision (relance controlee), avant migration des flux comptables.

themeStudioReact.description: M5 (2026-06-29) — Theme Studio React dev-only (app manager). 2 themes: vitrine + panel (panel = Manager/Admin + Dev). Vocabulaire UI = Panel ; mapping panel <-> backend scope manager.

Compat: /api/vitrine/theme, /api/theme/:scope, scope='manager', Vanilla intacts. @bs/ui mapBackendThemeToTokens + api-client PublicVitrineTheme/mapVitrineTheme transmettent les nouveaux tokens (live au prochain load).
themeStudioReact.feature: apps/manager/src/features/themeStudio/ — ThemeStudioLayout, ThemeStudioDashboard, ThemeEditor (vitrine/panel), ThemeForm + champs (Color/Typography/Radius/Shadow/Spacing/LogoSlogan), ThemePreview (apercu live local via CSS vars inline, sans save), ThemeStatusCard, ThemeActions, MobileThemeToolbar. themeDraft.ts (logique + hex hors .tsx). themeStudioReact.next: M6 — Mail Template Studio, ou extension Theme (couleurs semantiques + presets), ou actions de supervision mail.

mailTemplateStudioReact.description: M6 (2026-06-29) — Mail Template Studio React dev-only (app manager). Edition templates e-mail (versions/publish/rollback/apercu) sans hardcoder d'adresses. BACKEND INCHANGE (endpoints versioning Phase 5A existants ; apercu front).
mailTemplateStudioReact.apiClient: packages/api-client/src/manager/mailTemplates.ts — listMailTemplates/getMailTemplate/listMailTemplateVersions/createMailTemplateDraft/publishMailTemplateDraft/archiveMailTemplateDraft/rollbackMailTemplate/previewMailTemplate (FRONT, aucun envoi) + getTemplateRoleBinding (miroir safe de mailDispatchRules, ROLES uniquement) + extractTemplateVariables/KNOWN_TEMPLATE_VARIABLES. mailTemplateStudioReact.limits: pas d'envoi de test reel, preview front (pas d'endpoint backend dedie), pas de suppression definitive, pas d'edition mailDispatchRules, catalogue variables curate (miroir renderer, pas par-template), editeur HTML brut (pas de WYSIWYG). Verrou final backend.
mailTemplateStudioReact.next: M7 — endpoint backend de preview/rendu fidele, ou migration flux comptables (sale.finalized/commissions), ou extension Theme.

notificationStudioReact.description: M7 (2026-06-29) — Notification Studio dev-only (app manager) + vrai modele NotificationCategory. Le template ne connait PAS le scope (admin/dev/both) : le moteur le choisit. Backend ADDITIF.

L'enum legacy `category` n'est JAMAIS alimentee par un slug M7 (validation) : le slug va dans categoryId/categorySnapshot.

notificationEngineTemplateRuntime.limits: centre de notifications React non refait (notifications.ts = types-only, prepare M9) ; pas de seed auto de templates par type (un type sans template publie reste en legacy, volontaire).
notificationEngineTemplateRuntime.next: M9 — refonte du centre de notifications React (consomme categorySnapshot/priority/persistent/action) + eventuel endpoint manager de liste.

notificationCenterReactM9.apiClient: frontend-react/packages/api-client/src/manager/notifications.ts : NotificationScope/Summary/Detail/Stats/Filters/Action/CategorySnapshot, listNotifications(scope,filters?), getNotificationStats(scope) [derive], markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead, deleteNotification, resolveNotificationAction(action,ctx). Scope->endpoint admin/dev.

Documentee Folder/Manager/Vitrine.
notificationCenterReactM9.limits: pas d'archivage (endpoint inexistant, suppression seulement) ; stats derivees front ; centre dans l'app manager uniquement (vitrine sans notifs internes) ; actions sans route prete -> bouton 'Bientot disponible'.
notificationCenterReactM9.next: M10 — appliquer la Motion Guideline a un ecran metier reel, ou endpoint stats leger + polling intelligent, ou notifications temps quasi-reel (SSE) si besoin.

planningGlobalInstitutM10.description: M10 (2026-06-29) — Decision metier FERME : une seule entite = l'institut, plus de multi-prestataires. Calendrier GLOBAL type Planity (app manager). Formations presentielles incluses. Reservations/annulations/remboursements/acomptes/soldes sur place geres depuis le planning. Additif & non destructif.

CalendarItem SAFE (client.name jamais d'e-mail) : type(service_booking|formation_session|blocked_slot), paymentStatus, refundStatus, totalAmount, depositAmount, amountPaidOnline, balanceDueAmount, actionLinks{detail,cancel,markBalancePaid,reschedule}, sourceModel/sourceId.

planningGlobalInstitutM10.actions: Endpoints EXISTANTS : detail GET /bookings/:id/detail ; annuler (flow refund) POST /bookings/:id/cancel ; solde paye sur place POST /bookings/:id/balance-paid. Report admin : AUCUN endpoint -> UI desactivee (pas de logique inventee).

planningGlobalInstitutM10.limits: champs practitionerId non supprimes (legacy nullable, cleanup futur) ; pas d'endpoint report admin (UI preparee) ; paiements participants formation non exposes ; checkout prod garde practitionerId (=institut), chemin global teste en parallele.

m11aCheckoutGlobalBooking.availability: controllers/availabilityController.js getAvailableSlots : practitionerId query LEGACY sans effet ; creneaux institut. getAvailableDays inchange. Contrat API inchange.

Vanilla checkoutModule.js envoie encore practitionerId : accepte/ignore. Aucun nouveau texte prestataire.
m11aCheckoutGlobalBooking.notTouched: Modeles/index/slot-locks/PractitionerProfile CONSERVES (aucune suppression DB). Flux reschedule/refund inchanges (cible institut via snapshot) -> conversion reportee M11B. Planning manager inchange.
m11aCheckoutGlobalBooking.suites: p0 44, p1 589, integration 6, audits 36+20 ; React 165 + lint + build. Secret scan RAS.
m11aCheckoutGlobalBooking.limits: practitionerId non supprime physiquement (cleanup M11B) ; reschedule remboursement encore via createServiceBookingWithProtection (cible institut) ; pas d'endpoint report admin.

lastZeroPaymentFinalizationUpdate.title: Finalisation des achats 0 EUR (100% carte cadeau / gratuite)
lastZeroPaymentFinalizationUpdate.principle: Single finalizer reused: processCheckoutStatePurchase (same as Stripe webhook). No parallel business flow, no duplicated sale/booking/debit logic.
scope: finalizeFreeCheckout handler in clientController.js calls processCheckoutStatePurchase with requireZeroRemaining: true.

requireZeroRemaining threaded into processCheckoutStatePurchase / processCartCheckoutStatePurchase / processServiceCheckoutStatePurchase + inline branches; assertZeroRemainingForFreeOrder throws 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED if a balance remains due (after server-side planGiftCardUsage).

Idempotence reuses Phase 1B-1 unique partial index: synthetic free_<idempotencyKey> stored in Sale.stripePaymentIntentId; double submit -> E11000 -> idempotent; waitForExistingFreeSale resolves the winner under concurrency.
Gift-card debit unchanged: debitGiftCardBalanceAtomic via finalizeGiftCardUsage (never negative, capped to amount due).
STRIPE_FEE_PENDING_QUERY excludes free_* refs (no Stripe fees on a 0EUR order).

officialBehavior.casA: Cart fully covered by gift card (remaining 0): no Stripe, Sale created, card debited, booking created if applicable, post-sale effects.
officialBehavior.casB: Gift card larger than amount: debit capped to amount due, remainder kept, Sale created.
officialBehavior.casC: Genuinely free item (price 0): Sale created, finalized, no Stripe.
officialBehavior.remainingDue: Balance still due -> 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED (must go through Stripe).

lastZeroPaymentFinalizationUpdate.tests: tests/p0/giftcard.zeroPayment.characterization.test.js (it.todo -> real test): 100% gift card (sale+booking+debit), card > amount (capped debit), free product (no Stripe), double submit (one sale/one debit), refuses if balance due. Harness: 18 files, 60 passed, 0 todo, 0 expected-fail.

lastZeroPaymentFrontendWiringUpdate.title: Cablage frontend achat 0 EUR vers finalize-free
scope: checkoutModule routes zero-due attempts (single item, cart, service due-now=0) to slug=payment with checkoutToken + freeCheckout=1 instead of finalizing locally or touching Stripe.
vitrine.js now forces paymentResultModule for query.freeCheckout=1 in addition to payment_intent.

paymentResultModule reads checkoutToken from sessionStorage, calls POST /api/client/checkout/finalize-free with idempotencyKey=checkoutToken, and reuses the same success/failure screen as the Stripe return flow.
purchaseFlowService exports getCheckoutAmountDue(checkoutState) and submitFreeCheckoutRequest({ checkoutState, idempotencyKey }); finalizePurchase no longer depends on mock-pay for 0 EUR paths.
Stable frontend idempotency: zero-payment paths reuse a checkoutToken derived once per attempt and memoized from a checkoutState fingerprint without volatile timestamps.

rxBlocker2ManagerUsersInvitations.description: RX-BLOCKER-2 (2026-07-03) — Comptes manager par invitation tokenisee + reset mot de passe route par role.
